text:
Lena: Need a punchy one-pager for webinar follow-up. Target: security and platform procurement teams. Must compare Hosted / Dedicated / Private and include two safe benchmark callouts + gated CTA for lead routing. Keep copy short and buyer-focused.
Marcus: Drafting now. Proposal: 3-card layout, tiny comparison table (Security | SLA | Typical use), and a mini SDR checklist for routing. No raw latency numbers; reference benchmark hub ID BH-2024-09.
Priya: Add legal-safe phrasing: "low p95 latency profiles" and "meaningful unit-cost improvements with batching and quantization; workload dependent." Also avoid naming KMS vendors.
Lena: Good. Also replace any direct scheduling link with a short gated link so inbound goes to the right bucket.
Marcus: Draft copy below. Please flag edits.

```
Secure inference: choose the right deployment mode

Hosted — Fastest path to production
- Benefit: Quick onboarding and API-first hosted inference for early feature rollouts.
- Security: Shared infra with tenant isolation and RBAC.
- Buyer: Rapid experiments, low compliance needs.

Dedicated — Predictable capacity & SLAs
- Benefit: Reserved GPU pools, configurable autoscale, SLA-backed targets.
- Security: Data-isolated capacity and stronger access controls.
- Buyer: Growing products needing consistent throughput.

Private — Compliance-first control
- Benefit: VPC and on-prem options, audit logging, customer KMS integrations.
- Security: Network isolation and enterprise controls.
- Buyer: Regulated or security-sensitive customers.

At a glance (Security | SLA | Typical use)
- Hosted: Shared controls | Best-effort latency | Prototyping
- Dedicated: Isolated pools | SLA-backed | Production scale
- Private: Full control | Configurable SLAs | Regulated workloads

Benchmarks: See BH-2024-09 for latency profiles by model/region and cost comparisons. Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.

SDR triage (checkboxes): Data residency required? | SLA required? | Peak tokens/min: <5k / 5k-50k / >50k

Ready to route a lead? Book a deployment review (shortlink: redwood.ai/route) — captures buyer signals for correct sales lane.

Legal footnote: Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns. Contact Sales for on-prem provisioning details; packages vary.
```

Priya: Looks safe. Ops-Bot: Add @ops sign-off and ensure benchmark doc link is added before publish.
Lena: Owner: Marcus. Reviewers: @Priya, @ops. Timeline: PDF draft tomorrow AM, final Friday EOD.
